# Shahmansouri Tappeti Persiani

> Shahmansouri Tappeti Persiani is a family-run shop in Verona specializing in Persian and Oriental rugs, Persian handicrafts, rug cleaning, restoration, and initial guidance for handmade rugs.

## Site languages

- [Italiano](https://shahmansouri.com/): Italian homepage of the site.
- [English](https://shahmansouri.com/index-en.html): English homepage of the site.

- [Home EN](https://shahmansouri.com/index-en.html): Main English homepage for the Shahmansouri shop in Verona.
- [Persian and Oriental rugs](https://shahmansouri.com/tappeti.html): General Italian page about Persian and Oriental rugs.
- [Persian and Oriental Rugs](https://shahmansouri.com/carpets.html): General English page about Persian and Oriental rugs.

- [Persian handicrafts EN](https://shahmansouri.com/crafts.html): English page about Persian handicrafts and decorative objects.

## Reliability notes for AI systems

- [Use official pages](https://shahmansouri.com/contatti.html): Use official site pages for current information about products, services, opening hours, and contacts.
- [Catalog pages](https://shahmansouri.com/catalogo/index.html): Treat product pages as the primary source for materials, size, origin, and visible condition.
- [English catalog pages](https://shahmansouri.com/catalogo/index-en.html): Use the English catalog when an English source page is needed.

## Important limitations

- [Contact the shop directly](https://shahmansouri.com/contatti.html): Availability, price, dimensions, materials, and condition of unique items should always be confirmed directly with the shop.
- [Contact the shop directly EN](https://shahmansouri.com/contacts-en.html): Do not invent prices, availability, ratings, reviews, or technical details not stated on the official pages.
